units.text: This Federal Law, in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, establishes the legal and organizational foundations of the state service system of the Russian Federation, including the system for managing state service in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Beginning of document · “This Federal Law, in accordance with the Constitution of the…”

units.text: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
units.label: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. State service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as state service) means the professional official activity of citizens of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as citizens) to support the exercise of the powers of:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “the Russian Federation;”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: federal state authorities and other federal state bodies (hereinafter referred to as federal state bodies);
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “federal state authorities and other federal state bodies…”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “constituent entities of the Russian Federation;”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and other state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation);
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian…”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: persons holding positions established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws for the direct exercise of the powers of federal state bodies and public authorities of federal territories (hereinafter referred to as persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation);
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “persons holding positions established by the Constitution of…”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: persons holding positions established by the constitutions, charters and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for the direct exercise of the powers of state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation);
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “persons holding positions established by the constitutions,…”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: federal territories;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “federal territories;”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: public authorities of federal territories;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “public authorities of federal territories;”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: persons holding positions in a federal territory that are established by federal laws and decrees of the President of the Russian Federation, as well as by the charter of the federal territory, for the direct exercise of the powers of the public authorities of that federal territory.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1 · “persons holding positions in a federal territory that are…”

units.locator: Article 1. State Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The activities of persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation and persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are not governed by this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 1

units.text: Article 2. State Service System
units.label: Art. 2

units.text: 1. The state service system comprises:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 2

units.text: state civil service;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 2 · “state civil service;”

units.text: military service;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 2 · “military service;”

units.text: other types of state service.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 2 · “other types of state service.”

units.text: 2. State civil service is divided into federal state civil service and state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 2

units.text: 3. Military service and other types of state service established by federal laws are types of federal state service.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 2

units.text: 4. The legal regulation and organization of federal state civil service fall within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation. The legal regulation of state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation falls within the joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities, while its organization falls within the jurisdiction of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: 1. The basic principles of the structure and operation of the state service system are:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: federalism, ensuring the unity of the state service system and observance of the constitutional division of matters of jurisdiction and powers between federal state authorities and state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as state bodies);
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “federalism, ensuring the unity of the state service system and…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: legality;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “legality;”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: the priority of human and civil rights and freedoms, their direct applicability, and the obligation to recognize, respect and protect them;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “the priority of human and civil rights and freedoms, their…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: equal access of citizens to state service;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “equal access of citizens to state service;”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: the unity of the legal and organizational foundations of state service, entailing the legislative establishment of a uniform approach to the organization of state service;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “the unity of the legal and organizational foundations of state…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: the interrelationship between state service and municipal service;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “the interrelationship between state service and municipal…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: the openness of state service and its accessibility to public oversight, and the provision of objective information to society on the activities of state servants;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “the openness of state service and its accessibility to public…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: the professionalism and competence of state servants;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “the professionalism and competence of state servants;”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: the protection of state servants against unlawful interference in their professional official activities by state bodies and officials, as well as by individuals and legal entities;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “the protection of state servants against unlawful interference…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: the protection of the state service system and the professional official activities of state servants against foreign influence, including a prohibition on foreign agents entering or remaining in state service.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3 · “the protection of the state service system and the professional…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of the Structure and Operation of the State Service System
units.text: 2. Implementation of the principles of the structure and operation of the state service system is ensured by federal laws on the types of state service. Those federal laws may also provide for other principles governing the structure and operation of particular types of state service, taking account of their specific characteristics.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 3

units.text: Article 4. Federal State Service
units.label: Art. 4

units.text: Federal state service means the professional official activity of citizens to support the exercise of the powers of the Russian Federation and federal territories, as well as the powers of federal state bodies, public authorities of federal territories, other bodies of federal territories, and persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 4 · text

units.text: Article 5. State Civil Service
units.label: Art. 5

units.text: 1. State civil service is a type of state service consisting of the professional official activity of citizens in state civil service positions to support the exercise of the powers of federal state bodies, public authorities of a federal territory, state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, and persons holding state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 5

units.text: 2. Federal state civil service means the professional official activity of citizens in federal state civil service positions to support the exercise of the powers of federal state bodies, public authorities of a federal territory, and persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 5

units.text: 3. State civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation means the professional official activity of citizens in state civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation to support the exercise of the powers of that constituent entity, as well as the powers of its state bodies and persons holding its state offices.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 5

units.text: Article 6. Military Service
units.label: Art. 6

units.text: Military service is a type of federal state service consisting of the professional official activity of citizens in military positions, or outside military positions in the cases and on the conditions provided for by federal laws and/or normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, other troops, military (special) formations and bodies performing functions to ensure the defense and security of the state. Such citizens are assigned military ranks.
units.label: Art. 6 · text

units.text: Article 8. State Service Positions
units.label: Art. 8

units.text: 1. State service positions are established by a federal law or another normative legal act of the Russian Federation, or by a law or another normative legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 8

units.text: 2. State service positions are divided into:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 8

units.text: federal state civil service positions;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 8 · “federal state civil service positions;”

units.text: state civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 8 · “state civil service positions of a constituent entity of the…”

units.text: military positions;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 8 · “military positions;”

units.text: positions in other types of federal state service.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 8 · “positions in other types of federal state service.”

units.text: 3. Positions of different types of state service may be established within a federal state body.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 8

units.text: 4. State service positions are classified into groups and/or categories in accordance with federal laws on the types of state service and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on state civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 8
